name: images-tools
description: Resize, compress, round the corners of and convert images right on Jensen's image page, with a Rust backend that agents can call too
author: Jensen

scripts.test: bun test test && cargo test --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml

jensen.backendBuild: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml && cp backend/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/images_tools.wasm backend.wasm

tools.name: info
tools.description: Read an image's format, pixel size and file size without changing it. Works on png, jpeg, gif, webp, bmp, ico, tiff and svg.

path.description: Project relative path of the image

tools.name: resize
tools.description: Resize an image. Give a width, a height, or both; with both and keepAspect (the default) the image fits inside that box. The file is rewritten in place, or written to out with the source kept. SVG is redrawn sharp at the new size as a PNG next to the original.

path.description: Project relative path of the image

out.description: Write the result here instead of next to the source

keepOriginal.description: Keep the original file when the result has a different path. Defaults to true except for convert.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing a different file that already exists at the destination

tools.name: compress
tools.description: Make an image file smaller without changing its pixel size. JPEG uses quality, PNG is recompressed losslessly (and stored as a palette when it has 256 colors or fewer), SVG is minified. The file is rewritten in place, or written to out; it is left alone when it cannot get smaller.

path.description: Project relative path of the image

out.description: Write the result here instead of next to the source

overwrite.description: Allow replacing a different file that already exists at the destination

tools.name: round_corners
tools.description: Round an image's corners with smooth, transparent edges. radius is in pixels, or a percent of the shortest side when percent is true (50 makes a circle). A JPEG, BMP or GIF becomes a PNG written next to it, and the original is kept unless keepOriginal is false.

path.description: Project relative path of the image

out.description: Write the result here instead of next to the source

keepOriginal.description: Keep the original file when the result has a different path. Defaults to true except for convert.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing a different file that already exists at the destination

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert an image to another format. The new file has the new extension and replaces the original, unless keepOriginal is true or out is given. Targets: png, jpg, webp (lossless), gif, bmp, ico (256 px or smaller), tiff. SVG is drawn as a raster and the SVG is kept. Refuses to overwrite a different existing file unless overwrite is true.

path.description: Project relative path of the image

width.description: For SVG sources: the raster width

keepOriginal.description: Keep the original file instead of replacing it

out.description: Write the result here instead of next to the source
